description: Defines classes and structures for decoding video frames, including FrameDecoder, VideoFrameDecoder, and MediaImageDecoder, with methods for extracting frames, handling format options, and processing video data within the Android media framework.

classes.name: FrameDecoder
classes.description: Abstract base class for decoding video frames, providing interface for initialization, frame extraction, and format handling.

classes.name: VideoFrameDecoder
classes.description: Derived class for decoding video frames with support for specific video formats like AVC and HEVC.

classes.name: MediaImageDecoder
classes.description: Derived class for decoding media images, supporting tile-based decoding.

classes.name: FrameRect
classes.description: Structure representing a rectangular region within a video frame.

methods.name: FrameDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the frame decoder with component name, metadata, and source.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with frame time, options, and color format.

methods.name: extractFrame
methods.description: Extracts a frame, optionally within a specified rectangle.

methods.name: getMetadataOnly
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a track with specified color format, thumbnail option, and bit depth.

methods.name: onGetFormatAndSeekOptions
methods.description: Virtual method to get format and seek options, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: onExtractRect
methods.description: Virtual method to handle rectangle extraction, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: onInputReceived
methods.description: Virtual method to process input buffers, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: onOutputReceived
methods.description: Virtual method to handle output buffers, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: trackMeta
methods.description: Returns track metadata.

methods.name: dstFormat
methods.description: Returns destination color format.

methods.name: captureFormat
methods.description: Returns capture pixel format.

methods.name: dstBpp
methods.description: Returns bytes per pixel for destination format.

methods.name: setFrame
methods.description: Sets the current frame memory.

methods.name: extractInternal
methods.description: Performs internal extraction process.

methods.name: VideoFrameDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for video frame decoder with specific video format support.

methods.name: onGetFormatAndSeekOptions
methods.description: Overrides base method to get format and seek options for video frames.

methods.name: onExtractRect
methods.description: Handles rectangle extraction; currently unsupported for sequences.

methods.name: onInputReceived
methods.description: Processes input buffers for video frames.

methods.name: onOutputReceived
methods.description: Handles output buffers for video frames.

methods.name: initSurface
methods.description: Initializes the rendering surface.

methods.name: captureSurface
methods.description: Captures the current surface frame.

methods.name: MediaImageDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for media image decoder supporting tile decoding.

methods.name: onGetFormatAndSeekOptions
methods.description: Overrides to get format and seek options for media images.

methods.name: onExtractRect
methods.description: Handles rectangle extraction for media images.

methods.name: onInputReceived
methods.description: Processes input buffers for media images.

methods.name: onOutputReceived
methods.description: Handles output buffers for media images.
